title: Nostalgia
story: Things from a time when everything clicked, spun and rang.

cards.name: Cassette
cards.subject: A rectangular audio cassette with a clear grey plastic shell, a white label across the top, and a window showing two round tape reels with sprocket holes.
cards.hero_colors: light grey shell, white label, black reels, small orange stripe on the label

cards.name: Rotary Phone
cards.subject: A classic rotary desk phone with a glossy rounded body, a round dial with ten finger holes in a perfect circle, and a handset resting across the top of the body with a short coiled cord joined to the body.
cards.hero_colors: glossy red body and handset, cream dial face

cards.name: Record Player
cards.subject: A wooden-cased record player with a round platter holding a black vinyl record, and a thin tonearm hinged at the rear corner of the case, its needle resting on the record.
cards.hero_colors: warm wood brown case, black record, silver tonearm, red record label

cards.name: Phone Booth
cards.subject: A tall red telephone booth with a flat roof, a grid of clear glass panes on all four sides, and a front door with a handle on the right side, a payphone with a phone icon visible inside.
cards.hero_colors: red frame, clear glass panes, gold door handle

cards.name: Instant Camera
cards.subject: A boxy instant camera with a large round lens at the front, a small flash window in the top corner, a shutter button on top, and a square photo print with a simple sun icon sticking out of the slot on top.
cards.hero_colors: cream body, black lens ring, blue shutter button

cards.name: Roller Skates
cards.subject: A pair of quad roller skates, white high-top leather boots with laces, each with two pairs of wheels under the sole and a rubber toe stop at the front.
cards.hero_colors: white leather boots, white laces, pink wheels

cards.name: Tube TV
cards.subject: A chunky box television with a rounded-corner glass screen set in a wood-grain cabinet, two round knobs below the screen and a speaker grille strip beside it.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown cabinet, pale grey screen, silver knobs

cards.name: Lunch Box
cards.subject: A rectangular metal lunch box with rounded corners, a domed lid, a folding carry handle on top, two latches on the front, and a small house pictogram printed on the lid.
cards.hero_colors: blue metal body, white house pictogram, red latches

cards.name: Game Console
cards.subject: A handheld game console held upright: a rectangular screen on top, a cross-shaped directional pad on the left, two round buttons on the right, and a small speaker grille at the bottom right.
cards.hero_colors: light grey body, pale grey screen, red buttons

cards.name: Alarm Clock
cards.subject: A twin-bell alarm clock with a perfectly round face with twelve tick marks and two hands, two round bells on top with a small hammer between them, a winding knob on the back and two short legs under the body.
cards.hero_colors: teal body, white face, silver bells

cards.name: Instant Camera
cards.subject: A boxy instant camera with a large round lens at the front, a flash window in the top corner, a shutter button on top, and a square photo print with a simple sun icon coming out of the slot on top.
cards.hero_colors: cream body, black lens ring, red shutter button

cards.name: Rotary Phone
cards.subject: A classic rotary desk phone with a glossy rounded body, a round dial with ten finger holes in a perfect circle, and a handset resting across the top with a short coiled cord joined to the body.
cards.hero_colors: mint green body and handset, pale yellow dial face

cards.name: Cassette
cards.subject: A rectangular audio cassette lying flat seen from above, with a plastic shell, a white label across the top and a window with two round tape reels.
cards.hero_colors: orange-brown shell, white label, black reels, small blue stripe on the label

cards.name: Tube TV
cards.subject: A chunky box television with a rounded-corner glass screen in a wood-grain cabinet, two round knobs below the screen, standing on a low wooden TV stand against a wallpapered wall.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown cabinet, pale grey screen, silver knobs
cards.surface_or_setting: low wooden TV stand in front of a plain living-room wall

cards.name: Pocket Watch
cards.subject: A round gold pocket watch with a perfectly round white face with twelve tick marks and two hands, a crown and ring on top, and a short chain loop attached to the ring.
cards.hero_colors: gold case and chain, white face, red second hand

cards.name: Typewriter
cards.subject: A manual typewriter with a rounded body, four curved rows of round keys, a roller at the back holding a blank sheet of paper, and a long carriage lever on the left end.
cards.hero_colors: dark teal body, white keys, white paper, silver lever

cards.name: Spinning Top
cards.subject: A wooden spinning top standing on its point: a round belly narrowing to a pointed tip, a short peg on top, painted with a band around the middle.
cards.hero_colors: red painted body, wood peg, yellow band

cards.name: Jukebox
cards.subject: A rounded-top jukebox with a glowing curved arch window showing a row of records, chrome trim around the arch, and a chrome grille at the bottom, standing on a black-and-white tiled floor.
cards.hero_colors: red cabinet, chrome trim, yellow glowing arch
cards.surface_or_setting: black-and-white tiled diner floor in front of a plain wall

cards.name: Suitcase Player
cards.subject: A portable record player in a rectangular carry case with a round platter holding a black record, a silver tonearm hinged at the rear corner resting on the record, and a carry handle on the front side.
cards.hero_colors: red case, cream trim, black record, silver tonearm

cards.name: Mailbox
cards.subject: A silver metal mailbox with an arched top, a hinged front door with a small round knob, a red flag attached to its side, and a small house pictogram on the door, mounted on a wooden post planted in the ground.
cards.hero_colors: silver grey body, red flag, wood brown post

cards.name: Cassette
cards.subject: An audio cassette with a black plastic shell, a white label across the top with a red stripe, and a window with two round tape reels.
cards.hero_colors: black shell, white label, red stripe

cards.name: Rotary Phone
cards.subject: A classic rotary desk phone with a glossy rounded body, a round dial with ten finger holes in a perfect circle, and a handset resting across the top with a short coiled cord joined to the body.
cards.hero_colors: yellow body and handset, white dial face

cards.name: Gumball Machine
cards.subject: A gumball machine with a round clear glass globe full of gumballs on a red base, a round silver turn knob on the front and a small chute flap at the bottom, on a short round foot.
cards.hero_colors: red base, clear glass globe, red and yellow gumballs, silver knob

cards.name: Arcade Cabinet
cards.subject: A tall upright arcade cabinet with a slanted control panel holding one joystick and two round buttons, a screen showing a simple white heart icon, and a rounded top marquee panel with a star icon.
cards.hero_colors: blue cabinet, black screen, white heart, red joystick ball and buttons
cards.surface_or_setting: carpeted arcade floor against a plain wall

cards.name: Kite
cards.subject: A diamond-shaped kite with a cross frame inside, a tail of bow ribbons attached along a line from its bottom point, and a string attached at the center flying in a clear sky.
cards.hero_colors: red kite, wood frame, yellow tail bows

cards.name: Milkshake
cards.subject: A tall milkshake glass with a pink shake, a swirl of whipped cream on top, a red cherry on the cream, and a straw standing in the glass.
cards.hero_colors: pink shake, white cream, clear glass, red cherry

cards.name: Turntable
cards.subject: A light blue record player in a rectangular case with a round platter holding a black record, a silver tonearm hinged at the rear corner resting on the record, and four short round feet.
cards.hero_colors: light blue case, black record, silver tonearm, yellow record label

cards.name: Grandfather Clock
cards.subject: A tall wooden grandfather clock: a rectangular base, a long narrow body with a glass door showing a swinging gold pendulum disc, and a square head with a perfectly round white clock face with twelve tick marks and two hands.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown case, white face, gold pendulum
cards.surface_or_setting: wood floor against a plain wall

cards.name: Instant Camera
cards.subject: A boxy instant camera with a large round lens at the front, a flash window in the top corner, a shutter button on top, and a square photo print with a simple sun icon coming out of the slot on top.
cards.hero_colors: cream body, black lens ring, red shutter button

cards.name: Roller Skates
cards.subject: A pair of quad roller skates, white high-top leather boots with laces, each with two pairs of wheels under the sole and a rubber toe stop at the front.
cards.hero_colors: white leather boots, white laces, pink wheels
